questions.text: The given table shows the number of students studying Computer Science Engineering and Data Structures from six colleges.Study the table to answer the question that follows. What percentage of the students in college A5 study Data Structures out of the students studying CSE and DS?
In an election between two candidates, one person got 35% of the votes and lost by 6 votes. Assuming that there were no invalid votes, what was the total number of votes?
A chair was sold for ₹8,601 after giving two successive discounts of 8.5% and 6%. Find the marked price.
Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3500 as a sum borrowed at 4% per year rate of interest for 3 years.

Sunita borrows ₹5,500 for 3 years at 6.5% per annum simple interest. She immediately lends it to Vedanshi at 9.3% per annum simple interest for 3 years. Find her gain (in ₹) in the transaction per year.

In a ration shop, there is a certain amount of cereals to distribute to 42 families for 15 days. If 48 kg of cereals can be distributed to 30 families for 7 days, then the quantity of cereals already in the shop was:

In a circular race of 1100 m, P and Q start from the same point, at the same time and at speeds of 36 km/h and 63 km/h, respectively. When will they meet again for the first time on the track if they are running in the opposite direction?
The average weight of a family of five members (in kg) whose weights are 40 kg, 49 kg, 56 kg, 72 kg and 35 kg is:
How much water should be added to a 30 l mixture of milk and water, which currently has a ratio of 7 : 3, so that the resultant mixture contains 40% water?
Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3500 as a sum borrowed at 7% per year rate of interest for 5 years.
Reeta buys 90 kg potatoes and sells them at a profit equal to the cost price of 40 kg potatoes. Find her profit percentage.
By selling an article for ₹19.5, a dealer makes a profit of 30%. By how much should he increase his selling price (in ₹) so as to make a profit of 35%?
The average weight of a family of five members (in kg) whose weights are 40 kg, 49 kg, 56 kg, 68 kg and 39 kg is:

The bar graph shows the number of books published by a company in different years. In which year(s) the number of books published is more than the average number of books published in the mentioned years?
The mean of five numbers is 55. If one of the numbers is excluded, the mean gets reduced by 5. Which of the following is the excluded number?
If the total surface area of a hemisphere is 192π cm2, then the radius of the base of the hemisphere is:

A cylindrical glass with a diameter of 20 cm is having the juice to a height of 9 cm. An ice cube of size 8 cm is amerced in it completely. How much will the juice level rise in the glass? (Use π = 3.142 and answer correctly up to the nearest mm)
A motor car starts with a speed of 60 km/h and increases its speed after every two hours by 15 km/h. In how much time will it cover a distance of 450 km?
